svg.title: E03 ARTEMIS STRATODOSE engineering architecture
svg.desc: Environmental spectra are folded through detector response before count comparison. The dose branch requires its own validated sensitivity; shield response changes cannot automatically establish human-dose or orbital reliability benefits.
